_comment: Transcribed from the 42 page images of "Trekeasy - 500 Seed Users" (the .docx was deleted before it could be parsed). Validated by scripts/build-500-dataset.mjs: email shape, real calendar dates, and email/username cross-checked against each password. The random 5-digit email suffixes and the DOB digits cannot be validated by anything — they are transcription, so treat a sign-in failure for a single row as a likely misread.
